rules.headings: MUST use Anton. Apply `tracking-normal` or `tracking-tight` (Anton is inherently condensed). MUST use uppercase for all H1/H2. Avoid generic sans-serif for any large display text.
rules.body: MUST use Manrope. Use `tracking-wide` for small labels, `leading-relaxed` for paragraphs.

colors.rules: Strict adherence to the provided palette. Do NOT introduce generic blacks (#000) or pure whites (#FFF). The dominant background MUST be #F4EFE6 (Cream) with #0E3B2C (Forest Green) text, or inverted for high-impact sections (Green bg, Cream text). Use Red and Orange strictly for hover states, badges, price tags, or CTA buttons to make them pop.

layout_and_grids.spacing: Use generous padding: py-24 md:py-32 for sections. Avoid tight, cluttered layouts.
layout_and_grids.bento_grid: For the menu or gallery, use an asymmetrical bento grid. Example: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-8`. Span items irregularly (e.g., col-span-8, col-span-4) to create tension.
layout_and_grids.borders: Use 1px solid borders (`border-[#0E3B2C]`) to create an editorial, newspaper-like structure for the menu and footer.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay across the entire site to give it a tangible, printed-paper feel.
visual_enhancers.marquees: MANDATORY: Use infinite scrolling marquees for section transitions or announcements (e.g., 'OUR DESSERT — Freshly Baked. Every Single Day.'). Use `react-fast-marquee`.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Solid background (Orange or Dark Green). MUST have magnetic hover effect (framer-motion) or strong color inversion on hover.
visual_enhancers.badges: Use circular stamp-like badges for 'Best Seller' or 'Add Flavours @ ₹30'. Rotate them slightly (e.g., `-rotate-12`) for an urban/streetwear vibe.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky nav. Starts transparent, becomes solid cream or dark green on scroll. Large typography for links. Order Online CTA highlighted.
components_strategy.hero: Split aesthetic or overlapping text. Massive 'SECTION-B' text behind the hero drink image. Line-by-line staggered reveal of the headline.
components_strategy.menu_section: Categorized tabs (Cold Coffee, Hot Coffee, Food, Desserts). Use Shadcn Tabs but strip the default styling. Make it look like a printed menu board. Include dotted leaders for prices if possible, or bold alignment.
components_strategy.gallery_showcase: Masonry layout or Framer Motion powered horizontal scroll carousel for packaging and cafe interior shots.

motion_and_interactions.animations: Use `framer-motion`. Staggered text reveals (line-by-line or word-by-word) for all H2s. Parallax effects on images during scroll. Clip-path reveals for section transitions.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Image scale-up on hover inside hidden overflow containers (`group-hover:scale-105`). Button text swap or fill animations.

cafe_interior_2.description: Cafe counter and lights for Gallery.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install '@studio-freight/lenis' for smooth scrolling and initialize it in the main layout.
Install 'framer-motion' and use it extensively for scroll-triggered entrance animations.
Install 'react-fast-marquee' for the editorial ticker strips.
DO NOT use generic centered bootstrap-style layouts. Embrace asymmetry and print-editorial aesthetics.
Ensure all text contrasting against #0E3B2C or #F4EFE6 is highly legible. Use #D93A3A (Red) and #E07B2F (Orange) for striking accents only.
For the Menu section, implement a filtering system (Hot, Cold, Food, Desserts) with clear prices in ₹.
Include an Instagram order CTA linking to '@sectionb.in'.
Use standard semantic HTML/Tailwind for complex overlapping marketing layouts rather than fighting Shadcn layout components.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios are met. Add aria-labels for all icon buttons.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='order-online-button').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.responsive: Mobile-first approach. Ensure massive typography scales down appropriately using fluid typography (e.g., text-[12vw] to clamp) or discrete Tailwind breakpoints so it doesn't break the viewport on small devices.
